notes: Reframes the existing Brand Brain UI as the approved user-facing Brand surface while preserving the Brand Brain domain model underneath.
Moves ordinary Brand edits to inline-first local Save/Cancel interactions using the existing exact-version field write contract.
Separates evidence Sources from authenticated publishing/Insights Channels.
Adds a dedicated Brand Channels overview using existing channel-account and Meta health/OAuth contracts; no token or raw scope detail is exposed in normal UX.
Avatar and AI/Media Providers are excluded because no persistence/configuration contract exists yet; they require separate governed slices rather than fake UI.
No API, worker, migration, provider, tenant-boundary, publishing or analytics-collection change is authorized.
No production deployment is authorized while Vercel capacity remains deferred.
VS-88 was certified on 930a6bd8b2dac5092f549b4eea19b4786436a58c and merged as dda4223a191953619768a90a6bc19f25609df495; release and production-enable remain deferred.

approvals.rationale: The Product Owner said Go next after VS-88 merged and after the next Brand/Channels work was identified. The bounded frontend-only scope was stated before implementation.
Existing Brand confirmation, source provenance, Meta OAuth, publishing capability and learning policies are reused unchanged.
The Product Owner instructed the next approved UI implementation to proceed. Runtime work is limited to existing frontend contracts and no-deployment boundaries.
Requires exact-SHA Product Intake, Security, full CI and explicit Product Owner certification.
